reader_summary.overview: In this episode of PortfolioCasts | Investor Portfolio Podcasts, we break down the portfolio of Stephen Mandel, founder of Lone Pine Capital. Lone Pine follows a concentrated, research-driven approach focused on high-quality growth businesses. Holdings covered include:META, AMZN, MSFT, TSM, UNH, INTU, CRM, BKNG, KKR, COF, SBUX, PM, ASML, EQT, APP, CVNA, LPLA, FLUT, BN, TLN, and more.
